title: WrestleMania XIV
summary: This document provides a comprehensive overview of WrestleMania XIV, the 14th annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), held on March 29, 1998, at the FleetCenter in Boston, Massachusetts. Notable as the first WrestleMania of the Attitude Era and the first since 1986 without Bret Hart, the document covers the event's production background, the storylines leading into the show, detailed match descriptions, and the aftermath. Key highlights include "Stone Cold" Steve Austin defeating Shawn Michaels in the main event to win the WWF Championship for the first time, boxer Mike Tyson serving as the special ring enforcer for that match, and The Undertaker defeating his kayfabe half-brother Kane. The document details the storylines heading into the event, including feuds involving the Legion of Doom, Owen Hart and Triple H, Marc Mero and Sable versus Goldust and Luna Vachon, Ken Shamrock versus The Rock, and the Cactus Jack/Chainsaw Charlie versus The New Age Outlaws Dumpster match. The aftermath section describes the changing of the guard in the WWF, with Shawn Michaels' four-year injury hiatus, the full ushering in of the Attitude Era, the formation of the DX Army under Triple H with the returning X-Pac, the continuation of the Undertaker-Kane feud leading to the first Inferno Match, and Rocky Maivia's takeover of the Nation of Domination.
